structured.rankingRationale: Ranked highest where a repeatable, multi-day, airport-corridor hospitality mechanism exists without a confirmed competing hotel (IATA training; then ARCI pending venue verification). Confirmed Palexpo and incumbent-hotel events remain commercially useful but are labelled constrained or monitor-only. One-day or Lausanne events rank lower unless lodging/transfer evidence emerges.

notesForDeepResearch: Verify named accommodation partners, participant-arranged lodging and overflow channels for Palexpo events.
Prioritize IATA Geneva training sessions, ARCI venue/sourcing, and SETAC accommodation-channel intelligence.
For all confirmed competitor venues, seek future-edition rotation or evidenced overflow before sales outreach.
materialUncertainties: Most Geneva events have confirmed non-hotel or competing venues; no candidate is treated as open inventory solely because sourcing was not found.
Published room blocks and attendance are generally absent; qualitative demand only is reported.
Lausanne relevance is conditional on evidence of participant transport or lodging to YOTEL.
ARCI may overlap operationally with the already-pipelined DAUS programme and needs de-duplication review.
ICGTCE evidence is from a secondary conference listing and needs primary-source verification.
